title: The Hallway Painting
description: A woman in a dark blue uniform stands in a dimly lit room holding a flashlight and a set of keys, illuminating a large painting on an easel. The painting depicts a long, mysterious red hallway with wooden doors, wall sconces, and patterned flooring, while rain falls outside an arched window beside a wooden desk with a green lamp.
prompt: A woman in a dark uniform stands in a vintage office holding a flashlight and keys, pointing the light at a large realistic painting on an easel that shows a long mysterious red hallway with wooden doors and glowing sconces. Rain streaks down an arched window behind her. A wooden desk holds an open book, a green banker's lamp, and a teacup. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
